output.rootCauseExplanation: The root cause is a mismatch on product_units.conversion_factor for unit "CARTON" (product prod-cement-40): the value on record is 10.0000, but the value captured in the baseline snapshot at seed time was 12.0000 (source: baseline_snapshot.conversionFactor.CARTON, captured 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z). The difference is -2.0000.
output.businessImpactExplanation: The reconciled primary exposure is 28800000.00 IDR, computed as the sum of two disjoint components proven not to overlap (onHandAffectedUnits (1440.000) + soldAffectedUnits (1440.000) = totalBaseIn (2880.000); quantityOnHand = totalBaseIn - totalBaseOut is a structural accounting identity, so a base unit is either on hand or sold, never both — the two exposure components are proven disjoint): an inventory-value component of 14400000.00 on 1440.000 units still on hand, and a realized-COGS component of 14400000.00 on 1440.000 units already sold. The raw statement footprint (43200000.00 IDR) is a separate, larger figure that sums every affected statement line including a restatement of the same delta as gross profit — it is reported for transparency only and must not be read as the exposure.
output.remediationRationale: The proposed corrections (RESTORE_CONVERSION_FACTOR on product_units:pu-carton.conversion_factor (10.0000 -> 12.0000); REGENERATE_INVENTORY_VALUATION on inventory_valuation:val-cement-40.quantity_on_hand (960.000 -> 1440.000); REGENERATE_INVENTORY_VALUATION on inventory_valuation:val-cement-40.average_cost (60000.00 -> 50000.00); REGENERATE_INVENTORY_VALUATION on inventory_valuation:val-cement-40.inventory_value (57600000.00 -> 72000000.00); RECONCILE_JOURNAL_ENTRIES on journal_entries:2026-01.cost_of_goods_sold_reconciliation (72000000.00 -> 72000000.00); REGENERATE_GROSS_MARGIN_REPORT on gross_margin_report:gmr-2026-01.cost_of_goods_sold (86400000.00 -> 72000000.00); REGENERATE_GROSS_MARGIN_REPORT on gross_margin_report:gmr-2026-01.gross_profit (21600000.00 -> 36000000.00); REGENERATE_GROSS_MARGIN_REPORT on gross_margin_report:gmr-2026-01.gross_margin_percentage (20.0000 -> 33.3333)) restore the conversion factor to its baseline-proven value and regenerate every downstream figure that depended on it, without touching any already-posted journal entry directly; RECONCILE_JOURNAL_ENTRIES only re-confirms the ledger matches the recomputed COGS.
